To start off, I've been playing this game on/off since before official launch, I was actually a "Founder" for purchasing the founder pack waaaay long ago. It's accurate to say my experiences with this game are mostly positive, and I feel it's my duty to explain some of the points other people have in their reviews more in depth.

Starting off:

Pros: 
-Free
-Graphically flexible(can run on a bad pc or a great pc)
-Solid weapons, mechanics, etc.
-Compared to most BR games, this game still feels unique compared to others I've played.\
-Well designed maps
-Good character design


Cons:
-Bots?(see more later)
-Sometimes glitchy(mostly when jumping off high areas and trying to use the grappling hook. if the game stutters when doing this, you will die.
-Repetitive?(Usually the game is more or less locked to one map for a majority of the time, but it does change. also there are limited time game modes that appear, usually with a different map than the set map. Otherwise don't expect the set map to change more than once every season.

Now to get into some of the points up above. I'll start by saying that in addition to playing this game over a few years, currently (season 12) I've really enjoyed getting back into it and I am currently #22 in solo's in the game, so I would say its safe to say I more or less know what I'm talking about.

-Bots: I'm not too sure if they exist in the game, but I think it'd be safe to say that they do exist, and they do make the game a bit easy. I've never seen any official posts or patch notes regarding bots but I also never really kept up much with the game news since I play on/off a lot. Bots really just make the game lose appeal after a while, and as far as I can tell, it doesn't matter how good or bad you are, you might just get a game full of them, or with almost none. I'm ranked very high and I run into what I feel are bots very often. (more so in squads than in solo's) either that or the player base skill has really gone downhill.

-Desert Map/the season 10/11 catastrophe: This seems to be(from reviews/things I've heard from friends) to be pretty much the most hated map in ROE existence, but I would like to preface this saying that I've personally never played it, since I believe it was introduced in season 10 or 11, which I did not play during. Currently, in season 12, this map is not in rotation, so I have no gripes with it considering I pretty much love both the other maps. The game currently is not portrayed very well by the screenshots on steam, as almost all of them are season 11/10 which are basically widely hated(from my perspective) so I believe it is unfair to judge the game based on those few seasons/one map.

-Thoughts on current season compared to how I felt about previous seasons:
Honestly I've had a ton of fun playing this game this season, mainly because I can actually get into lobbies fairly quickly, very consistently. The main reason I played on/off was that usually the wait times for lobbies used to be extremely high(like 15 minutes to get into a game) The current season has no issues with this but I would probably attribute this due to the fact bots seem to be in the game now.
Season 1 was incredible for its time, offered a fresh new take on the BR genre and did it well. Season two introduced a new map: Europa Island, and a variety of new weapons, traversal options, customization items, etc. Season two was probably my all time favorite. Since then, I haven't noticed a whole ton of innovation to the game, as major changes only happen at the beginning of each season. The game seems to be in a state of "Return to Form" as it is fairly similar to how it was back in season 2, which I believe is probably caused from the backlash of the desert map.

In game store/loot- There are in game purchases for this game, mostly for the premium currency. Honestly, the currency is fairly cheep, and you can buy enough to get a battle pass for a whole season for about 10 bucks. The game also has another currency that you get for playing the game, ranking well, getting kills, winning etc, called coins. Coins can be used to purchase weapon skins/trinkets etc. which offers a f2p model for getting cool loot.(Although if you aren't consistently winning, farming up coins will most likely take a long time.) Otherwise, you're better off getting the battle pass, and maybe buying a few loot boxes.

Crashes/Glitches:
Throughout my time playing this game I have seen minimal issues regarding crashes/glitches. Currently, there seems to be an issue with the steam overlay being enabled, which may cause your game to crash randomly. I myself have the overlay disabled, and my game still seems to crash every once in a while. The only other gripes I have is that when jumping from high altitudes with the grappling hook, the game may stutter/glitch, and if this happens while you use your grappling hook, you will most likely die from fall damage.

I run this game at absolute maximum settings, and honestly I'd say besides COD, and maybe Apex, this game looks better than pretty much every other BR game I've ever played.

All in all, very solid game, if they marketed more, and fixed a few things, honestly it could be genre defining. There's a lot of good here, and a lot of questionable things as well, but I'll update this if anything big ever happens that I think deserves a review.
